para.text: The hydraulic conductivity for this model was previously estimated using PEST and the estimated results were already imported into this model. However, those results were not used to change the hydraulic conductivity of the model. To change them, select Data|Edit Data Sets and change the default formula for the Kx data set from 0.0001 to RmaMf6Completed_Kx_1.
